title: 锐雯·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 白色短发衬出绿色双眼，巨大的断裂符文剑保持静止。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Riven is an adult woman with short tousled white hair, green eyes, a worn green-and-brown outfit, one armored shoulder, and an enormous broken runic sword. Her long-sleeved opaque tunic, patched trousers, wrapped gloves, and boots cover the body, while the sword’s fractured broad shape remains recognizable.
art_direction.scene: A slightly elevated complete figure, asymmetric curved silhouette, naturally separated hands and a small sunlit ground cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: sage green, ivory, brown, pale green edge light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
